Change in the criterion with each added class

Source: R/wildcards.R
plot_deltas.Rd

The decrease in the information criterion of an enumeration grid with each added profile and each added group class (BIC over groups on a profile or class grid, BIC on the others).

Usage

plot_deltas(x, main = NULL, subtitle = NULL)

Arguments

x

An enumeration grid.

main, subtitle

Title and subtitle; NULL (default) keeps the view's own.

Value

A ggplot object. An object with nothing to draw raises latents_nothing_to_plot, naming the plot functions that apply; an object the package did not return raises latents_not_a_fit.

See also

get_deltas() and get_knees() for the tables; plot_selection().

Examples

grid <- enumerate_lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"),
                      n_profiles = 1:3, model = "EEI",
                      n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
plot_deltas(grid)
